title: CSCI 569 — Seminar in Theory
subject: Algorithms and Theory
description: An independent, catalog-aligned learning companion. It is not an official RIT course section or a replacement for the instructor's syllabus.
outcomes: Define the stable process for piloting new undergraduate theory courses by identifying faculty-led proposal requirements and cluster classifications.
Explain the standards and planning methods for determining course details, including prerequisites, format, learning outcomes, assessment methods, and
Evaluate representative examples of Theory cluster courses to understand how to apply evaluation criteria for faculty proposals.
